data.description_suggestion: Sends a custom email to a lead using a connected email identity. Required: message (object with html and text versions), identityId (connected email identity), and either leadId or leadEmail (lead identifier). Email threading: provide one of replyInLastThread (boolean), replyToMessageId (specific message ID), or subject (new email subject). Optional: cc and bcc (comma-separated recipient lists). Returns email confirmation with ID and delivery status. Fails with 'Conversation not found' if no existing conversation between identity and lead. Note: identityId must match a connected email identity in your account.

This is a webhook receiver endpoint (not a direct API call). Configure this URL in your RB2B dashboard (Integration > La Growth Machine), replacing 'Your-external-apikey' with your actual API key. Each visitor identified by RB2B is pushed into the audience specified in the URL path (default: 'RB2B_Website_Visitor'). Audience names can be customized by replacing the path segment; spaces in names are preserved as-is. RB2B visitor fields are mapped to LGM lead fields: LinkedIn URL, First/Last Name, Title, Company Name, Business Email, Website, Industry, Employee Count, Revenue Estimate, Location, State, Zipcode, Referrer, Captured URL, and Tags. Returns 200 OK on successful receipt.
